dimension_description: Surface tension is the energetic cost of creating more liquid surface, usually expressed as force per unit length. It is highly sensitive to temperature and contaminants, so these are representative values rather than immutable constants. This scale is useful for comparing cryogenic fluids, common liquids, and unusual high-tension metals.
